A '''pick'''<ref name="SWS" /> or '''pick axe'''<ref name="HR">''[[Heroes & Rogues]]''</ref> was a tool.<ref name="SWS" /> They were often used by [[Xenoarchaeology/Legends|xenoarchaeologists]].<ref name="HR" /> A powered version of the pick was the [[Vibropick/Legends|vibropick]].<ref name="SWS" />
